title: Founder keyword and sense map
source: October 30, 2026 founder voice-conversation transcript and philosophy-chromatophore source
interpretation_boundary: working meanings are not founder verbatim; no automatic synonym equivalence, authority or executor

entries.working_meaning: A useful next state feels available without rebuilding the whole view.
entries.distinction: Do not equate with zero network/compute latency.

entries.working_meaning: Investigate zero/one decisions and the separate meanings of encoded bits versus a compiled executable.
entries.distinction: Do not collapse Boolean state into a Go/Rust binary.

entries.working_meaning: Explore the smallest governing semantic/operating core that survives changing faces and bindings.
entries.distinction: Not a request to build an OS kernel or duplicate Automata.

entries.working_meaning: Preserve what a concept means and its original Primary Intent, not just the spelling on the screen.
entries.distinction: Meaning must not be silently inferred as permission.

entries.working_meaning: One identifiable semantic or functional unit that can carry typed relationships and changing bindings.
entries.distinction: A node is not automatically a process, screen, actor or executor.

entries.working_meaning: Multiple nodes can be connected, composed, compared and presented as a structure.
entries.distinction: Plurality does not imply an arbitrary fixed node count.

entries.working_meaning: Possible shorthand or EGG-like reference to stable identity or meaning across representations.
entries.distinction: Not necessarily a model token, bearer credential or security token.

entries.working_meaning: Explore when different words point to the same sense or capability and how equivalence is justified.
entries.distinction: Similar wording is not automatically identical identity, authority or behavior.

entries.working_meaning: Distinguish a named value or binding that can change while the reference remains stable.
entries.distinction: Variable values must not rewrite source intent unnoticed.

entries.working_meaning: A named position that can receive different approved content or targets.
entries.distinction: A blank slot does not authorize arbitrary content or action.

entries.working_meaning: Visible form changes while the underlying subject and binding contract remain consistent.
entries.distinction: A biological analogy is not runtime proof.

entries.working_meaning: A valid change moves through rebind rather than a replacement surface.
entries.distinction: Animation alone does not prove preserved state.

entries.working_meaning: Change which value, target, form or interface an existing reference resolves to.
entries.distinction: Must preserve intended identity and owner admission.

entries.working_meaning: Nine-position conceptual stamp: four corners, four midpoints and one center.
entries.distinction: Nine positions do not mean every system has nine physical parts.

entries.working_meaning: Eight channels plus a head illustrate many contributions converging.
entries.distinction: Not a software scheduling algorithm.

entries.working_meaning: An SNF EGG is a compact stable identity whose target may change through valid bindings.
entries.distinction: EGG does not equal the entire SNF nor confer permission.

entries.working_meaning: A compact expression/slot that resolves to currently bound meaning or content.
entries.distinction: Do not confuse shortcode syntax with full application state.

entries.working_meaning: Connect an existing stable identity or slot to a current value, source or target.
entries.distinction: A mapping is not inherently an authorized effect.

entries.working_meaning: What is carried by a node, expression or interface, independent of its visible style.
entries.distinction: Payload swaps can have data-owner and policy consequences.
entries.source: founder-intent.md; Morph Triad ACT V5 docs

entries.working_meaning: The visible unit used to explain retained surface and movement.
entries.distinction: 'Same pixels' is a design law/metaphor until measured.

entries.working_meaning: How a semantic subject becomes visible on a current surface.
entries.distinction: Form does not determine execution permissions.

entries.working_meaning: What an owned operation actually does regardless of presentation.
entries.distinction: Function must be backed by a real owner.

entries.working_meaning: Values, bindings and context can change at runtime.
entries.distinction: Dynamic is not unrestricted.

entries.working_meaning: Replace or recombine qualified components without rebuilding the whole subject.
entries.distinction: Compatibility and ownership matter.

entries.working_meaning: Why a Master Node or creation exists; descendants stay within its scope.
entries.distinction: A new UI cannot silently rewrite Primary Intent.

entries.working_meaning: Same subject, draft, selected state and acknowledged result through changes.
entries.distinction: Smooth visuals alone are insufficient.
entries.source: Optimus Instant philosophy; ACT V4 core

entries.working_meaning: The center is a new combined outcome of interacting parts, rather than just an extra part.
entries.distinction: Metaphorical fusion is not automatic integration.

entries.working_meaning: Manifest or transcript of what an actor/node becomes across contributions.
entries.distinction: Profile is not proof of live actor commissioning.
